new-object.description: Creates an instance of a Microsoft .NET Framework or COM object

-ArgumentList.description: Array of arguments passed to the constructor of the .NET Framework class.
-ArgumentList.requirement: Constructors that take a single array parameter must be wrapped inside another array.
-ArgumentList.error: New-Object: Exception calling ".ctor" with "1" argument(s): "Value cannot be null. (Parameter 'cert')"

-Property.description: Sets property values and invokes methods of the new object.
-Property.instruction: Enter a hash table (keys, values) are (property_name/methods, property_values/method_arguments).
-Property.factor2: methods are invoked in the hash tables order

PSObject.condition1: a new object is derived from the PSObject class
PSObject.condition2: a property is specified that does not exist on the object
PSObject.conditional result: New-Object adds the specified property to the object as a NoteProperty
PSObject.non-conditional result: If not a PSObject, the command generates a non-terminating error.

System.Management.WqlEventQuery.description: Represents a WMI event query in WQL format

Parameters.description1: commands rely on parameters for options/input.
Parameters.description2: A hyphen signals powershell what follows is a parameter.
Parameters.description3: Parameter names & values are seperated with a space/colon.

activity.instructions: use the following help commands to learn about parameters.
activity.Named positional parameters: may be put in any position.
activity.Parameter type: The Microsoft .NET Framework type is specified after the parameter name
activity.Multi-parameter: parameter types with an index specifier indicates multiple inputs.
activity.accepts pipeline by value: value can match Parameter type or be converted.
activity.accepts pipeline by property name: value must be same Parameter type as property
activity.accepts wildcard characters: parameter's value can contain wildcard characters

delay-bind script blocks.description: Parameters accepting pipeline input use delay-bind script blocks on the parameter.
